_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "decimals" INTEGER NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NULL, "name_l10n_key" TEXT NULL, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "is_token" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_token" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "l10n_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income')), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_types" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "l10n_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "default_currency" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account_types (id), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "opening_balance_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "amount_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "memo" TEXT NULL, "amount_formula" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "memo" TEXT NULL, "draft_amount_minor_units" INTEGER NULL, "draft_currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "draft_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "memo" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_of_week" INTEGER NULL, "day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "month_of_year" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "next_due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "last_error_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "memo" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "token_name" TEXT NULL, "token_symbol" TEXT NULL, "token_decimals" INTEGER NULL, "contract_address" TEXT NULL, "from_address" TEXT NULL, "to_address" TEXT NULL, "tx_hash" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "blockchain" TEXT NULL, "recurring_rule_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "rate_scaled_e9" INTEGER CHECK(rate_scaled_e9 > 0) NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX transactions_date_idx ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_account_idx ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category_idx ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX accounts_account_type_idx ON accounts (account_type_id)
CREATE INDEX shopping_list_items_account_idx ON shopping_list_items (account_id)
CREATE INDEX shopping_list_items_category_idx ON shopping_list_items (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recurring_active_due ON recurring_rules (is_active, next_due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_recurring_archived ON recurring_rules (is_archived)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_source ON pending_transactions (source)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_account ON pending_transactions (account_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_exchange_rates_pair ON exchange_rates (base_currency, quote_currency)
